messages:
mara: Heads-up — onboarding team hit a weird parity issue with the Go SDK. REST route create accepted model_variant and a `timeout` (seconds). Go client only exposes `TimeoutMs` and refuses unknown fields; server rejects with 422. Also saw duplicates because the SDK retries POSTs on 5xx by default.

aj: Strange, haven't seen Go-specific ones recently. Can you paste the exact REST vs Go examples?

mara: REST (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"name":"go-onboard","model":"gpt-open-3","model_variant":"v2","timeout":45}'
```
Go SDK (422):
```go
// using github.com/redwood/sdk-go v0.3.8
payload := routes.RouteCreate{
  Name: "go-onboard",
  Model: "gpt-open-3",
  TimeoutMs: 45000,
}
client.Routes.Create(ctx, payload)
// no ModelVariant field on RouteCreate; extra map[string]any not supported
```

sam: Confirmed on our side: SDK struct lacks ModelVariant and the encoder omits unknown top-level keys. Backend requires model_variant for some model backends and validates `timeout` as seconds int.

zara: The duplicate creation trace shows the Go transport retried once after a 502. No Idempotency-Key header sent.

mara: Logs: 
```
[2025-11-03T11:02:01Z] POST /v1/routes req=r_01 upstream=502
[2025-11-03T11:02:02Z] go-sdk retry -> POST /v1/routes req=r_02
[2025-11-03T11:02:02Z] POST /v1/routes req=r_02 created
```
Customer observed two routes because the first one was actually accepted by a flaky upstream before returning 502.

aj: Short-term workaround: set an explicit `Idempotency-Key` header and set the transport retry count to 0 for create calls. Example: 
```go
client.SetHeader("Idempotency-Key", uuid())
client.Transport.RetryPolicy.MaxRetries = 0
client.Routes.Create(ctx, payload)
```

sam: For safety, onboarding sample apps should avoid library-level auto-retries on non-idempotent endpoints until SDKs expose idempotency helpers.

zara: Proposed SDK fixes: 1) add ModelVariant to RouteCreate struct (optional string), 2) accept both Timeout and TimeoutMs in the constructor/helpers and normalize to seconds for wire, 3) do not perform automatic retries for POST unless caller sets an Idempotency-Key or opts into retrying non-idempotent ops, 4) provide a convenience helper to attach Idempotency-Key for users.

mara: I created ticket DEVEX-5010 with repro, sample app, and server logs. Adding a small integration test that compares JSON produced by the Go SDK vs canonical REST payload.

devex-bot: DEVEX-5010 created: "go-sdk: route create parity — expose model_variant, normalize timeout, and restrict POST retries; add idempotency helper" https://tickets.redwood/DEVEX-5010 :robot_face:

aj: I'll take the Go SDK changes. Plan: add ModelVariant, overload constructors to accept Timeout (s) or TimeoutMs (ms), change default Transport retry policy to only auto-retry idempotent methods, and add `WithIdempotencyKey()` builder. Will add unit tests and a small compatibility test with the API team.

sam: Ops follow-up: can we temporarily alert on multiple route creations from same account with identical payload within 3s window? That would catch duplicates until SDK changes roll out.

mara: (typo) I'll coordinate with eng-sre on the alert and will update the ticket with the mitigation steps for customers. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
